artworks.title: Father, Son, and Donkey
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two separate scenes involving figures riding a horse. The top portion of the drawing features two figures riding a horse, depicted with fluid motion using loose, flowing lines. The figures are roughly drawn with minimal detailing. The bottom portion shows a solitary rider on horseback with another figure walking beside the horse. The drawing uses simple lines and shading to suggest movement and companionship, with an emphasis on shape and posture rather than detailed features. The technique appears swift and spontaneous, suggesting a study or quick capturing of motion and form.

artworks.title: Village Scene
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered in an outdoor scene. The drawing depicts a group of shapes resembling human figures in various poses. Some figures are standing while others are crouched or leaning. The pencil lines are faint and preliminary, capturing the basic forms and poses without specific details or features. To the right, there are outlines of structures and possibly boats, suggesting a waterside setting. The minimalistic approach gives the impression of an artist's early compositional sketch, focusing mainly on layout and movement rather than refined detail. The drawing conveys a sense of motion and interaction within a simple, undefined landscape.

artworks.title: Son and the Donkey
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a group of figures. On the left side, there are three figures partially obscured, potentially standing, and wearing long garments or cloaks. Faces are not detailed, with emphasis on their clothing. On the right, a single figure is bending over, using a cane or stick for support and wearing a shorter garment. The background is shaded with sketches hinting at other figures or a landscape but lacks specific detail. The scene maintains focus on the central figures with a backdrop of loosely drawn lines and shading.

artworks.title: Ground Floor Plan for Torre Quatro Venti
artworks.medium: pen and ink and colored pencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ground floor plan. The floor plan is hand-drawn on paper and depicts the layout of a building's ground floor, including various rooms and features. The drawing includes labels for different areas such as the "kitchen," "pantry," "dining-room," "library or spare bedroom," "hall," "drawing-room," and "servant bed-room." Additionally, there are annotations marking features like "going up to olives," "against hill slope," and "pine trees below." The rooms are outlined with lines, and some areas are filled in with color, indicating different zones or functions. There are arrows and additional handwritten notes providing further details about the connections between these spaces. The drawing offers a detailed insight into the architectural design and spatial layout of this particular ground floor area.

artworks.title: Orte
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rugged terrain. The horizon is near the top of the composition, with distant mountains under an overcast sky. Delicate, sketch-like brushstrokes create a soft texture on boulders and vegetation. The color palette includes browns, beiges, greens, and muted blues. Large rocks, sparse vegetation, and a small building with a slanted roof are in the foreground. Ancient-looking structures are visible in the distance on the horizon.

artworks.title: The Shipwreck
artworks.medium: charcoal, watercolor, and gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene from an elevated point of view. Three boats are navigating rough waters: two small rowing boats with figures and a larger ship in the distance. The horizon blends into the overcast sky with dramatic clouds. The brushstrokes are expressive and loose, capturing the dynamic movement of waves and sky. The color palette is subdued with grays, blues, and white for the frothy water, conveying stormy weather.

artworks.title: Roman Landscape
artworks.medium: colored chalks on green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch with an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, dividing the sky from the land. The landscape includes hills, mountains, a river or stream, foliage, and trees. The sketch is created with loose brushstrokes using pencil and pastel. Earthy tones, grays, and white chalk are used for a subdued color palette. A road or path winds through the center, enhancing depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Fragment from a Wall in Capri
artworks.medium: graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fragment of a sculptural relief. The image shows a sketch of a section of architectural or sculptural stonework that includes a horse in profile and draped fabric. The drawing is executed in pencil or charcoal on a neutral paper, emphasizing the textures and curves of the stone's relief with shading. Some handwriting in Italian, possibly notes by the artist, is visible alongside the image.

artworks.title: Arco Oscuro--Over the Via Fiaminia
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The pencil drawing features a tree-lined path leading towards a dome structure in the distance. The horizon is high, with the dome and a smaller structure below it dominating the skyline. The sketchy and loose brushstrokes give the scene movement and texture. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of gray on off-white paper. The path is flanked by dense trees on the left and shaded foliage on the right, creating depth and directing the viewer towards the structures.

artworks.title: From the Rubáiyát
artworks.medium: graphite, black and white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of a person lying face down on a flat surface. The person's body is leaning forward, arms extended outward. The head is partially visible, with short textured and slightly curly hair. They are wearing a loose garment with visible folds. The right arm is outstretched with slightly bent fingers. The background is plain. Shading and white highlights emphasize the body and fabric contours.

artworks.title: Detail of the Marriage of the Daughter of the Vine
artworks.medium: colored pencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural column with an ornate top decorated with fantastical elements. The column twists upwards and ends in a intricately designed top with a shell-like scroll element. In the curve is a small figure or creature. A stylized wing or feather motif extends from the figure. Above them, a small burning lamp emits rays of light. The drawing is executed in a loose, sketchy style using dark lines on a light background.

artworks.title: Study for "Music"
artworks.medium: charcoal and pastel over graphite on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure and a musical instrument. The image includes a simplified depiction of a nude figure seated with one knee raised, leaning on an object resembling an ancient stringed instrument, possibly a lyre, enclosed within a circular frame. The use of shading and lines suggests movement and texture, giving the image a dynamic quality. A spiral shape and fluid-like forms in the background contribute to a sense of motion, creating a harmonious composition.

artworks.title: Five Heads
artworks.medium: pen and ink and watercolor on 5 sheets of wove paper mounted to folded wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image contains five rectangular shapes with intricate swirling lines and curves, creating abstract facial forms. The designs resemble stylized faces with features like eyes, mustaches, and hair patterns, reminiscent of decorative masks or gargoyles. The shapes are set within frames with distinct rounded or angular edges that enhance their abstract quality.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait: Caricatures
artworks.medium: charcoal and pastel on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image contains a pencil sketch on a piece of paper with roughened edges. The main focus is a head portrayed from the shoulders up. The face has a heavy expression with wrinkles and sagging features, indicating an elderly person. The hair is sparse and thinning. The sketch includes additional drawings such as a whimsical face in profile on the left and a mix of shapes and textures at the top right. The paper shows handwritten notes and the word "SQUARETOES" beneath the central figure. The background is plain with the paper texture visible.

artworks.title: Dawn
artworks.medium: crayon, gouache, gold paint, and graphite over silver gelatin developed-out print mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a figure with wings, stepping down some brick steps. One hand rests on a stone surface as the other reaches forward. The person has soft facial features and wavy hair. The wings are detailed and butterfly-like. There is a swirling halo around the wings and the background has swirling blue and gold hues.

artworks.title: Into the Universe
artworks.medium: silver gelatin developed-out print on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Borghi, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a tablet. The scene shows swirling lines in the background, with the figure draped in flowing garments. The hands are in a pose of calmness or contemplation. The figure holds a rectangular tablet with calligraphed text. The illustration is in monochrome shading, emphasizing texture and depth.

artworks.title: Au coq des bruyeres
artworks.medium: wood engraving on tissue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Eric Denker in honor of Jack and Rhea Denker and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor dining scene. The image shows a bustling outdoor café or garden party setting. There are several tables arranged under trees, with people seated at them. A waiter is serving drinks, balancing a tray. In the background, there are architectural elements resembling cottages or a communal building, blurred. An individual on a swing is seen in the upper right area. The shading and monochrome palette give the scene depth and ambiance.

artworks.title: Groupe de paysans (Group of Peasants)
artworks.medium: chine collé lithograph in black on Ingres de couleur paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane Atlas, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people working in agriculture. Two individuals are kneeling and focused on their task, with detailed textures created by varied brushstrokes. The horizon line is low, with small trees and bushes. The color palette is monochrome with earthy tones. The lines and brushstrokes create an impressionistic style, capturing countryside labor. In the distance, sparse vegetation merges into the sky with slight tonal variations.

artworks.title: Goat in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert A. Hauslohner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a goat climbing on a rocky surface next to a tree. The drawing depicts a goat in mid-motion, with its front legs elevated onto a rock, while its body is inclined upwards. The goat has long, curved horns and a shaggy coat. The tree next to the goat has detailed bark and leaves, and the rocky surface is illustrated with intricate lines. Shadows and cross-hatching techniques add dimension and realism to the scene.

artworks.title: The Cabin
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert A. Hauslohner
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a low horizon showing buildings in the distance, a dog near a barrel, a large tree providing shade, and an old stone structure with a wooden door. The brushstrokes give an etching-like appearance with a monochromatic color palette of sepia and black. The path leads towards the horizon, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: The Three Cows
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert A. Hauslohner
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a low horizon blocked by trees and thick vegetation. A cluster of trees and bushes is the main focus. Their reflections are visible in water, implying the presence of a river or pond nearby. The etching lines are dynamic and delicate, giving the image movement and texture. The monochromatic color palette uses black ink and light beige paper to create contrast. More trees in the distance are smaller and less detailed. The etching shows a detailed representation of a natural setting captured in a sketch-like manner.

artworks.title: The Large Cow Lying Down (Grosse Liegende Kuh)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on blotting paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert A. Hauslohner
artworks.description: This print depicts bold, sweeping lines and geometric shapes resembling a seated bull or cow. The lines of the print are in black against off-white paper, and some are thick and bold while others are thin. The bull’s head is slightly turned to the right, and its front legs are curled near the bottom-left corner. We can see the bull’s wide nose, its small eyes, its ears, and its large, curved horns. Its body on the right is less defined, and there is an indistinguishable shape on the right, near the bull’s head.

artworks.title: Jackdaws of Chartres
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert A. Hauslohner

artworks.title: Glenfinnan
artworks.medium: color etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert A. Hauslohner
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated angle, featuring a wide expanse extending into the distance. The horizon line is positioned centrally, dividing the intense blue sky from the muted land below. The horizon has no distinct features. The brushstrokes are fine and textured, creating a sense of movement and depth, especially in the sky with varying shades of blue. The predominant colors are cool blues, with hints of white and brown closer to the viewer, creating a tranquil effect.
